always had a positive experience with Broomhill Practice. When I’ve genuinely needed help, the doctors have been extremely supportive and professional, and I’ve felt listened to and taken seriously. I’ve had doctors call me back when needed and follow things up properly, which really makes a difference.

I know there are some negative reviews, particularly about reception, but I think it’s important to remember the pressure GP practices are under. They’re dealing with a huge number of patients every day, working long hours, and trying to balance limited resources. From my experience, staff have been doing their best in a very demanding environment.

No service is perfect, but based on my own experiences, I’m grateful for the care and support I’ve received here and wanted to share a more balanced
